every_quarter: Last pay stub and any 1099s so far (wages, gig/1099 income, dividends, interest).
Receipts and confirmation numbers for any quarterly payments already made.
Last year's tax return, to sanity-check the 100%-of-last-tax safe-harbor amount (110% if your prior-year AGI was over $150,000).
Bank routing and account numbers if paying by IRS Direct Pay or EFTPS; sign up for EFTPS a week ahead.

estimated_tax.shift_rules_note: Sheet-shifting rules: a due date that lands on a Saturday, Sunday, or federal/DC holiday moves to the next business day. Notable cases: MLK Day can be Jan 15 (e.g. 2024), and DC Emancipation Day (April 16, observed on the next weekday if it falls on a weekend) can push April dates to the 17th or 18th (e.g. 2023 and 2028).
estimated_tax.source_note: Bundled offline schedule for US federal estimated tax (Form 1040-ES) installments. Based on the IRS general rule (April/June/September in year, January of the next year) with weekend/federal-holiday shifts, including DC Emancipation Day effects. Verify on IRS.gov before paying. No IRS API is used.
